title: Task create validates only its own record, never another pending record's refs
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-19.
Evidence: `krn task create` exited 65 with `pending tasks/t-wmb4e0h.json: unknown resolution ref "t-1kt1vb9"`. An unrelated pending record named a task that existed only on an open branch, and that blocked every new task.
Files: src/task/ (create validation), test/task/*.test.ts
Outcome: create exits 0 and writes its record when another pending record names an unknown task; it prints one warning line naming that record.
Proof: a test with a pending record that names an unknown task shows create succeeding with a warning.
